description.de: 22 weltbekannte Klassiker nach IBA-Spezifikation – mit Gläsern, Zutaten, Garnituren, Fotos und einer fertigen Karte. Ohne Preise; Allergene und Alkoholgehalt sind Richtwerte zum Prüfen.
description.en: 22 world-famous classics following the IBA specs – with glasses, ingredients, garnishes, photos and a ready-made menu card. No prices; allergens and ABV are indicative values to review.

source: Recipes based on the IBA official cocktail specifications (iba-world.com). Descriptions: original texts by the Cocktail-Manager project. Photos: Wikimedia Commons contributors (CC0, Public Domain, CC BY 2.0/4.0, CC BY-SA 2.0/3.0/4.0). See the image credits for authors and licenses.
